title: A Compliment Then A Stomp
logline: A kaya tells the stomper he looks great up on his hill top and swears only one of them will grow old. Nine minutes later the stomper drops off his tower and proves him right.

segments.title: You look great from over here

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: and hey, it's Bob! He's chatting up his own killer.

narration.speaker: taborgreat
narration.text: you look great from over here on that hill top

narration.speaker: hank
narration.text: Flirting. He's flirting, in a death match! Bold, Bob.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: My nan says that to her pigeon every morning.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: Young man. He's taken it, Hank. He's taken the compliment!

narration.speaker: hank
narration.text: Ding ding ding, the romance is on!

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: Shush, he's typing again. I can feel it.

narration.speaker: taborgreat
narration.text: only one of us will grow old

narration.speaker: hank
narration.text: Oh. Oh, that's a threat with a smiley face on it.

narration.speaker: hank
narration.text: Nine minutes on, he's been bitten, shot, nearly blown up, and drunk thirteen stews!

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: So he builds a tower right next to dirt man's. To say hello!

narration.speaker: hank
narration.text: Shh. Shh. He's at the top, he's level with him.
